reason: I have bought enough software that promised to save me time and now I barely open half of it, the follow-up and the Monday paperwork get done by me at 11pm because I already know how. The free page is nice, but $950 to $2,500 is real money for something I would probably end up maintaining myself.
objection: I am already paying for tools I barely use, so how do I know this one does not join the pile? And passes the written test, who writes the test?
would_change_my_mind: A one-page write-up on my actual business that names something costing me money I had not spotted, plus one client in northern Illinois about my size who will take my call about whether the balance really was not charged.
